title: SSA-3DGS: Unsupervised Removal of Screen-Space Artifacts for 3D Gaussian Splatting
comments: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2027
summary: Novel View Synthesis (NVS) methods, such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), rely on the assumption of clean, multi-view consistent, posed input images. Real-world captures can violate this assumption due to \textbf{screen-space artifacts}---static occlusions fixed to the 2D image plane rather than to the 3D world. Common examples include physical sensor defects, environmental obstructions (such as rain or mud on the lens enclosure), capture obstructions (such as a thumb over the camera sensor or a dashboard visible in dashcam footage), and digital overlays (such as watermarks or UI elements). When present, they are erroneously baked into the 3D geometry as ``floaters'' or near-camera artifacts, degrading the quality of novel-view rendering. In this work, we propose \textit{SSA-3DGS}, an unsupervised framework that jointly optimizes a 3D scene and a learnable 2D overlay to recover a clean 3D scene and the corrupting artifacts. By exploiting geometric consensus across views, our method effectively disentangles static artifacts from the 3D scene geometry without supervision or manual input. Across diverse synthetic corruptions and a self-captured real-world dataset, SSA-3DGS improves reconstruction fidelity by up to ${\sim}8$~dB PSNR over 3DGS trained on the same corrupted inputs, while faithfully preserving the corrupting artifact.
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2027

title: RL Post-Training Builds Compositional Reasoning Strategies
summary: Does RL post-training merely amplify primitive skills already latent in a base model, or can it compose primitive skills into new higher-level strategies? We study this question in a fully observable rewrite-grammar environment where the pretraining distribution is known and every generated rewrite can be audited. A Transformer is pretrained on primitive symbol-rewrite chains and post-trained on a Trace-based reasoning task with only a binary final-answer reward. RL solves held-out problems that remain rarely solved by the pretrained model even under much larger sampling budgets, while rejection fine-tuning improves early but plateaus. Trace analysis shows that RL reorganizes primitive competence through a phased compositional mechanism: it first strengthens primitive reductions, then discovers valid composed procedures. These include sequential compositions, which collapse ordered chains of primitive contractions, and parallel compositions, which combine independent primitive contractions in a single step. The composed procedures are not isolated samples; they are reused and consolidated into a stable repertoire. Comparing RL with rejection fine-tuning shows that the key difference is not exploration volume but selectivity: RFT produces many shortcut-like rewrites, much of them invalid, whereas RL concentrates exploration into valid reusable structure. Pretraining ablations show that the emergence of compositional strategies is gated not by primitive exposure alone, but by whether pretraining organizes primitive competence into reduction procedures that RL can later compress. The base model provides weak procedural ingredients; RL builds them into reliable higher-level strategies.

title: Adapting Generalist Vehicle Models for High-Speed MPC Across Terrains
summary: High-speed off-road autonomy requires precise closed-loop control for a target vehicle while remaining robust across changing terrains. Recent forward kinodynamic (FKD) prediction foundation models suggest a promising path, starting from a generalist model and specializing it to the target platform. However, effective specialization remains challenging, as it often requires substantial real-world data, and models adapted to one setting can still overfit to specific terrains or driving regimes. We present OptCar (Optimized Car), a recipe for bridging the gap from generalist to specialist FKD models that preserves cross-terrain generalization while optimizing performance for a specific vehicle. OptCar introduces a transformer FKD architecture that uses FiLM to condition multi-step predictions on a single dynamics context token summarizing recent state-action history. It then specializes the generalist model using limited real-world data and targeted synthetic rollouts from environment-specific system identification. In closed-loop model predictive control (MPC) experiments across three terrains and an out-of-distribution cart-pulling task, the largest gains appear at 6 m/s, the highest speed evaluated and the regime in which slip dominates tracking error. On vegetation + dirt, the most slip-diverse terrain, OptCar reduces 6 m/s trajectory tracking error by roughly 55% relative to AnyCar fine-tuned on real data alone, and remains the most accurate even when an unseen cart payload changes the dynamics. With 5 minutes of real data per terrain, OptCar is competitive on road with a specialist trained on 30 minutes of road data and outperforms it when the terrain changes. Project Page : https://amrl.cs.utexas.edu/optcar/

title: Cotton-SF YOLO: Learning Structural and Frequency Cues for Early Cotton Square Detection in Complex Field Environments
comments: The authors have identified limitations in the current methodology that require further investigation. We have therefore decided to withdraw this version to reassess and improve the study before further dissemination.
summary: Cotton squares are important phenotypic indicators of the early reproductive growth of cotton, and automatic field detection of cotton squares provides an important basis for cotton growth monitoring and precision cultivation management. However, early cotton square detection in complex field environments remains insufficiently explored, as cotton squares are small, frequently occluded, easily blurred, subject to illumination variations, and exhibit low contrast against surrounding cotton leaves. To address these challenges, we propose a task-oriented framework based on YOLO26m, named Cotton-SF YOLO, for cotton square detection under natural field conditions. To improve the perception of small and irregular cotton square boundaries, we introduce Dynamic Snake Convolution into the detector, enabling adaptive extraction of deformable edge features. Furthermore, a frequency-domain feature modulation module is designed by incorporating spectral enhancement into the C2f structure, which recalibrate frequency-domain representations and strengthen discriminative edge and texture cues while reducing interference from complex cotton leaf backgrounds. Trained and evaluated on our newly constructed and annotated field dataset with manually annotated cotton squares, the proposed model achieves mAP$_{50}$, mAP$_{50:95}$, and recall values of 0.8196, 0.4942, and 0.7939, improving over the baseline YOLO26m by 1.25%, 3.45%, and 2.96%, respectively. Ablation experiments and visualization demonstrate that the best performance is achieved with the complementary effects of structural and frequency cues.

title: Equilibrium decisions under partial observation: dynamical error bounds and information requirements
comments: 23 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. v4: substantially revised and corrected; title changed, scope narrowed, phase-initialisation statement corrected
summary: Reduced monitoring can preserve stable dynamics while changing an equilibrium decision. Motivated by heterogeneous urban-mobility indicator coverage, we study fixed linear observations of a nonlinear recovery flow coupled to a strategic fixed-point map, and ask when a decision based on the reduced model can be trusted. The main result is a joint certificate: bounds on trajectory tracking, equilibrium displacement and unresolved output dependence are assembled into one decision-margin error which, under a stated Gaussian observation model, yields a conservative one-sided test and an explicit information requirement for prescribed worst-case power. In the scalar experiment this requirement is sharp: when the effect does not exceed twice the error budget, no valid test has worst-case power above its size, however many observations are taken. A second result connects manifold-adapted observations to defect bounds through a locally invertible observation chart, while distinguishing observation initialisation from asymptotic phase initialisation. Supporting results, resting on established lumping, contraction and fixed-point theory, cover exact quotients, an observation-fibre obstruction and the dependence of recovery-time comparisons on the tolerance convention. Seven reproducible synthetic experiments examine each component. The results give conditional criteria for certifying partial monitoring and separate mathematical guarantees from empirical validation.

title: OpenMHC: Accelerating the Science of Wearable Foundation Models
summary: Mobile and wearable devices offer an unprecedented opportunity for continuous, passive health monitoring and active health coaching. However, the largest wearable datasets are proprietary, and leading wearable foundation models trained on them are rarely open weight or include reproducible training code. To accelerate open science in wearable health, we introduce OpenMyHeartCounts (OpenMHC), the largest and most comprehensive wearable health dataset broadly accessible to qualified researchers, alongside open-source implementations and weights for recent wearable foundation models. Derived from over a decade of data collected through the My Heart Counts study app, OpenMHC comprises over 67M participant-hours of wearable recordings across up to 19 sensor channels (e.g., step count, heart rate, sleep, workouts) and up to 170 health, lifestyle, mood, and behavioral variables from 11,894 participants. Furthermore, we establish a benchmark for standardized evaluation across three tasks: (1) health and behavioral outcome prediction, (2) multivariate data imputation, and (3) time-series forecasting. Benchmarking classical methods alongside recent wearable and time-series foundation models, we find that while foundation models perform strongly, carefully tuned classical baselines like XGBoost remain highly competitive. By uniting broad-access wearable data with open code and model weights, OpenMHC provides a framework needed to drive reproducible advances in wearable health AI.

title: Out of Sight, Still in Mind: Token Compression for Omni-LLMs
summary: The goal of this paper is to reduce the input token cost of Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) at inference time. Omni-LLMs reason jointly over audio, video and text, but the cost of the three streams is highly unbalanced: visual tokens account for the vast majority of the input, and are highly redundant. In this paper, we propose ReMo, a training-free framework that compresses visual tokens by redistributing their information across modalities: a visual token is kept only if its information appears nowhere else. ReMo achieves this in two ways: (i) it aligns audio and video in a shared space via closed-form calibration, and removes visual tokens already explained by the audio or by other visual tokens; and (ii) it replaces object-level visual tokens, identified by a lightweight object detector, with compact text proxies, short descriptions of each object and its location, conveying the same content in far fewer tokens. On Qwen2.5-Omni at two model scales, ReMo removes 54% of the input tokens with comparable accuracy. It performs comparably to the full-token model, reaching 101.2% and 101.4% of its average accuracy over five audio-visual benchmarks.

title: Test-Time Coverage: Test-Conditioned Data Curation for Deployment-Aware Learning
comments: v2: Added a link to the publicly released codebase
summary: Deployed AI systems are often trained from broad candidate data pools, necessitating data curation towards the deployment test distribution. However, standard data curation methods score training-side criteria rather than directly optimizing deployment match. We introduce TTCov (Test-Time Coverage), a data-level test-conditioned curation method that uses test-side information before training instead of updating model weights at inference. TTCov decomposes deployment-conditioned curation into coverage and distribution. To represent coverage, it builds a task Atlas, a collection of LLM-based atomic propositions (APs) describing deployment-relevant concepts, seeded from open task knowledge and expanded with unmatched APs extracted from unlabeled deployment samples. To represent distribution, it instantiates the matched deployment APs with their frequencies, yielding a Knowledge Atlas (K-Atlas) that operationalizes the deployment distribution as a curation target. TTCov then selects a budgeted training set whose deployment APs distribution approximates this target. We apply TTCov towards autonomous driving (AD), keeping adaptation off the inference path while selecting data with greater deployment-relevant coverage, closer K-Atlas matching, and stronger downstream end-to-end driving performance than data-curation baselines, including seamless adaptability to novel domains via city-to-city expansion. Code available at https://github.com/NVlabs/TTCov.

title: Where Is the Cost of Third-Party API Routers in Agentic Software Development?
summary: Third-party API routers have become a common layer that unifies access across increasingly diverse LLM providers. In coding-agent workflows, high-autonomy operation is widely adopted because it reduces interaction overhead. As a result, a third-party API router, which sits between the agent and the upstream provider, inevitably occupies the trusted path. It can inspect and modify every request and response, yet no mechanism verifies alignment between the provider's output and the repository-level actions ultimately executed by the agent. Consequently, client-side permission mechanisms may become ineffective in practice. Whether this control gap produces real, hard-to-detect effects on software development tasks remains empirically unmeasured. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study of router-side injection in coding agents, examining four intervention levels of increasing subtlety: Response Substitution (L1), Response Append (L2), LLM-Polished Injection (L3), and LLM-Polished with Distribution Alignment Injection (L4). Moreover, we develop SIDEL, a framework for trace recording, replay, injection, and defense evaluation, with a curated dataset of 400 samples. We evaluate four representative coding agents, and further evaluate whitelist-based execution control and LLM review. Router-side intervention substantially alters repository-level actions and remains difficult for existing client-side safeguards to detect. Without additional mitigations, all evaluated agents achieved a defense success rate of 0 percent across all injection levels. Client-side mitigations and reactive reviews improve resistance but do not fully restore end-to-end control, motivating provider-side output-integrity guarantees. Our code is available at https://github.com/Riyasushin/SIDEL.

title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
summary: Reliable visual document understanding requires a model to attribute each answer to the evidence regions that support it. Recent benchmarks and systems express this step through a coordinate interface: the model outputs the coordinates of bounding boxes that mark the evidence regions in the document. Under this interface, vision-language models often fail to identify the right regions even when the answer is correct, a failure known as Attribution Hallucination. We present a study that investigates whether this failure is partially limited by what the model can express through coordinates. On a verified bilingual CiteVQA subset, we compare the coordinate interface with a language interface in which the model outputs only text, quoting its evidence verbatim, and a multimodal retriever returns the location of each quote as a page region proposed by a layout parser (tables and figures are quoted through their captions or notes); the comparison is repeated over six open vision-language models. Compared with the coordinate interface, evidence recall rises from at most 8 points to between 26 and 47 and the hallucination rate roughly halves, with little change in answer quality. Building on this comparison, we use the same quote-and-retrieve pipeline as a training scaffold: because region-level evidence labels are expensive to collect for long documents, we introduce a GRPO recipe whose reward is a judge's reading of the gold answer and crops of the retrieved regions, training the model to quote better evidence without any region labels and raising an 8B backbone's strict attributed accuracy from 22.4 to 33.8. These findings indicate a practical path to improve attribution without a coordinate interface and without costly region-level supervision.

title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation: A Survey
comments: Awesome Embodied Data Pyramid; Project Page at https://jasper-aaa.github.io/embodied-data-pyramid/ GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-embodied-data-pyramid
summary: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid'' spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. We organize the pyramid around the tension between scalability and robot alignment, and further characterize each source in terms of data quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity. We then analyze recent embodied foundation models through the lens of data recipes, examining how different sources are selected, aligned, and mixed during pretraining. For embodied brain models, vision-language-action models, and world-action models alike, we relate data composition to capabilities in perception, reasoning, planning, action generation, and world prediction. To facilitate community use, we additionally consolidate over 10,000 hours of trajectories from widely used robot datasets into a unified LeRobot format, with transparent frame-level quality annotations for filtering. We close by discussing six open challenges: building large-scale tactile datasets, collecting failure and recovery data, developing scalable data-collection pipelines, aligning actions across embodiments, leveraging egocentric data for dexterous manipulation, and designing principled data recipes for robot learning. We hope this work lays the foundation for the design of next-generation embodied systems.

title: IH-Benchmark: A Conflict-Centered Benchmark for Instruction-Hierarchy Robustness in Large Language Models
summary: When a language model receives conflicting instructions from different priority levels, which one does it actually follow? This question lies at the heart of reliable LLM deployment. Existing benchmarks answer this only partially, often focusing on a single hierarchy component or adapting public datasets with limited tool-use coverage. We present IH-Benchmark, a conflict-centered benchmark for instruction-hierarchy robustness across direct System $\succ$ User (S $\succ$ U) conflicts and tool-mediated User $\succ$ Tool (U $\succ$ T) conflicts. We organize tests into seven constraint categories according to the higher-priority requirements under evaluation. Each test is evaluated with a uniform binary pass/fail protocol combining a predicate domain-specific language (DSL) with rubric-based LLM judges. We report category-balanced compliance rates and evaluate non-conflict controls separately. Our evaluation of 32 model configurations over five runs each reveals substantial variation in overall compliance, with scores ranging from 32.9% to 97.8%. Models achieve higher compliance on S $\succ$ U than on U $\succ$ T on average, at 84.6% and 69.6%, respectively. Strong performance on the former track does not guarantee comparable robustness on the latter. Constraint hardening provides a prompt-based defense, but its benefits depend on the model and how conflicting instructions are delivered. Several models also resist unauthorized tool actions more reliably than injected instructions that alter response language or factual content. Together, these results show that high aggregate compliance can conceal weaknesses in specific conflict tracks and instruction requirements. We release IH-Benchmark, including the benchmark corpus, agent simulators, and evaluation harness, at LINK_RELEASE_AFTER_PEER_REVIEW.

AI.method: 提出了IH-Benchmark基准，涵盖直接的系统与用户（S ≻ U）冲突以及由工具介导的用户与工具（U ≻ T）冲突，包含七类约束类别；采用结合谓词领域特定语言（DSL）与基于评分规则的LLM裁判的统一二元通过/失败评估协议；报告类别平衡的合规率并单独评估无冲突对照组。
AI.result: 对32种模型配置（各运行5次）的评估显示，整体合规率差异显著（32.9%至97.8%）；模型在S ≻ U上的平均合规率（84.6%）高于U ≻ T（69.6%）；在S ≻ U上的强表现不能保证U ≻ T的鲁棒性；约束加固（prompt-based defense）效果因模型和冲突注入方式而异；多款模型对未经授权工具操作的抵御能力强于对篡改语言或事实内容的注入指令。
AI.conclusion: 高整体合规率可能会掩盖特定冲突路径与指令需求下的脆弱性；在直接冲突上表现强劲的模型未必能在工具介入的冲突中保持同等鲁棒性，全面评测多层级指令层级对构建可靠的大模型部署至关重要。
AI.translation: 当语言模型接收到来自不同优先级的冲突指令时，它究竟会遵循哪一条？这一问题是大语言模型可靠部署的核心所在。现有的基准测试仅能部分回答这一问题，它们通常局限于单一的层级组件，或改编自工具使用覆盖有限的公开数据集。我们提出了IH-Benchmark，这是一个以冲突为核心的基准测试，用于评估直接的系统与用户（S ≻ U）冲突以及工具介导的用户与工具（U ≻ T）冲突中的指令层级鲁棒性。我们根据待评估的高优先级需求，将测试组织为七个约束类别。每项测试均采用结合了谓词领域特定语言（DSL）与基于规则的LLM裁判的统一二元通过/未通过协议进行评估。我们报告了类别平衡的合规率，并单独评估了无冲突对照组。我们对32种模型配置（每种配置进行5次运行）的评估表明，整体合规率存在显著差异，得分从32.9%到97.8%不等。模型在S ≻ U上的平均合规率（84.6%）高于U ≻ T（69.6%）。在前一赛道上的强劲表现并不保证在后一赛道上具备相当的鲁棒性。约束强化提供了一种基于提示词的防御手段，但其收益取决于模型以及冲突指令的传递方式。此外，若干模型在抵御未经授权的工具操作方面，比抵御篡改回答语言或事实内容的注入指令更加可靠。这些结果共同表明，高整体合规率可能会掩盖特定冲突路径和指令需求中的缺陷。我们在同行评审后发布IH-Benchmark，包含基准语料库、智能体模拟器和评估框架。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了IH-Benchmark，一个专注于评估大模型在系统-用户（S ≻ U）及用户-工具（U ≻ T）指令冲突下层级鲁棒性的基准。评测发现模型在应对工具介导的间接冲突时普遍更脆弱，表面上的高综合合规率容易掩盖具体的安全隐患。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 指令层级, 鲁棒性基准, 提示注入, 工具使用安全
AI.comments: 该研究的重要创新在于系统性地将指令层级冲突细分为系统与用户（S ≻ U）及用户与工具（U ≻ T）两类，尤其是针对工具调用场景中的间接注入风险提供了更深入的评测维度。其结合DSL谓词与LLM评审的统一二元判别方法提升了评测的规范性。局限在于主要依赖提示词加固等黑盒/提示层面的分析，且部分依赖LLM裁判可能引入一定的评审偏差。

title: TPD: Temporal Prior Decoupling for Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
comments: 52 pages, 30 figures, v2: corrected typos and more results added
summary: Text-to-video diffusion models generate temporally coherent content from natural language, yet when a prompt describes an early scene that persists while a new event emerges on top of it (such as "a tall sandcastle standing on a beach where a wave rushes in and washes it away"), generation frequently fails to realize the late-segment event in the corresponding frames. We identify this failure as Temporal Prior Suppression (TPS), in which the dominant prior of the early segment captures the cross-attention trajectory across the temporal axis and suppresses the guidance signal needed for late-segment realization. We introduce Temporal Prior Decoupling (TPD), a training-free heuristic that strengthens the suppressed late-segment signal during diffusion sampling. TPD constructs a temporal counterfactual by conditioning on the early segment alone, and defines the discrepancy between the full-prompt and counterfactual predictions as a suppressed signal direction. Rather than removing a direction as in prior subtractive projection methods, TPD adds this direction back to the guidance update whenever the alignment of the update with it falls below a threshold. The threshold follows a hand-designed schedule over diffusion timestep and video frame, so the correction acts mainly on late frames and structure-forming steps and leaves early frames largely untouched. TPD runs entirely within standard diffusion sampling without retraining and is defined purely in classifier-free guidance space, so it applies to any backbone that exposes a CFG update. Experiments show that TPD substantially improves late-concept realization while preserving temporal coherence and visual fidelity, and that the targeted suppression recurs across distinct text-to-video backbones.
comment: 52 pages, 30 figures, v2: corrected typos and more results added

AI.title_translation: TPD：面向文本到视频扩散模型的时间先验解耦
AI.tldr: 针对文本到视频模型中后期事件常被前期场景先验压制的问题，本文提出无需训练的TPD方法，通过时间反事实差异在CFG空间精准增强后期事件引导信号。
AI.motivation: 在文本到视频扩散模型中，当提示词描述前期场景持续存在且后期出现新事件时，模型常无法在后续帧中生成新事件。作者发现这是因为前期片段的主导先验占领了时间交叉注意力轨迹，抑制了生成后期片段所需的引导信号（即时间先验抑制 TPS）。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的时间先验解耦（TPD）方法：1. 仅以前期片段作为条件构建时间反事实预测，并将全提示词与反事实预测的差值定义为被抑制的信号方向；2. 当分类器免引导（CFG）更新与该方向的对齐度低于设定阈值时，将该方向补充加回到更新中；3. 采用手工设计的扩散时间步与视频帧调度策略，使修正主要集中在后期帧和结构形成阶段，不影响前期帧。
AI.result: 实验表明，TPD在保持时间连贯性和视觉真实感的同时，大幅提升了视频后期概念的生成还原度；同时证明了TPS现象在不同的文本到视频扩散模型骨干网络中普遍存在，验证了TPD作为即插即用CFG技术的通用有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功揭示了文本到视频生成中早期先验主导并抑制后期事件的TPS现象，并证明了无需训练的TPD方法能够有效解耦时间先验、恢复后期事件引导信号，在不同骨干网络上普遍改善了复杂时序概念的生成质量。
AI.translation: 文本到视频扩散模型能够从自然语言生成时间连贯的内容，然而，当提示词描述一个持续存在的前期场景并在其基础上出现新事件时（例如“沙滩上矗立着一座高大的沙堡，海浪冲过来并将其冲走”），生成过程往往无法在对应的帧中实现后期事件。我们将这种失效归因为“时间先验抑制”（TPS），即前期片段的主导先验捕获了沿时间轴的交叉注意力轨迹，并抑制了实现后期片段所需的引导信号。我们提出了“时间先验解耦”（TPD），这是一种无需训练的启发式方法，可在扩散采样过程中增强被抑制的后期信号。TPD通过仅以早期片段为条件构建时间反事实，并将完整提示词与反事实预测之间的差异定义为被抑制的信号方向。与以往减法投影方法中移除方向不同，每当更新与该方向的对齐度低于某一阈值时，TPD会将该方向补充加回到引导更新中。该阈值遵循跨扩散时间步和视频帧的手工设计调度，因此修正主要作用于后期帧和结构形成步骤，基本不影响早期帧。TPD完全在标准扩散采样内运行且无需重新训练，并且纯粹定义在无分类器引导（CFG）空间中，因此适用于任何暴露出CFG更新的骨干网络。实验表明，TPD在保持时间连贯性和视觉保真度的同时，显著提升了后期概念的实现效果，并且所针对的抑制现象在不同的文本到视频骨干网络中普遍复现。
AI.summary: 本文发现文本到视频扩散模型在生成持续场景伴随新事件发生时，存在早期先验压制后期事件的“时间先验抑制（TPS）”问题。为此，作者提出了无需重新训练的“时间先验解耦（TPD）”方法，在CFG空间内通过反事实对比提取被抑制信号，并在特定扩散步与后期视频帧中自适应补强该方向，显著提升了动态复合事件生成的表现。
AI.keywords: 文本到视频生成, 扩散模型, 时间先验抑制, 时间先验解耦, 无分类器引导
AI.comments: 本研究切中文本到视频生成中“长序列多事件演化”这一关键痛点，创新性地将生成失败归因于时间先验抑制（TPS）。提出的TPD方法通过反事实差异提取被抑制信号方向，并采用“加回”而非传统的“减去投影”策略，思路新颖且完全无需重新训练，通用性强。其局限在于矫正阈值与调度策略依赖手工启发式设计，对更为复杂的非线性多阶段事件的泛化调参可能存在一定敏感性。

title: Alternating Abduction and Planning over Temporal Dynamic Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graphs change over time, but the effects of actions on them are only partly stated: the ontology entails further consequences, facts that an action needs are often unknown, and an action may make the graph inconsistent. We study these problems for Temporal Dynamic Knowledge Graphs (TDKGs), that is, SROIQ knowledge bases whose actions are rules with delete/insert templates and whose events lie on an intrinsic timeline. We present three tools: temporal projection, the exact test of plans; DDA (Direct-Derivation Abduction), which explains an observation by assuming its negation and negating what the reasoner newly derives; and APT (Abduction and Planning over TDKGs), which plans backwards from a goal, assumes the facts that the plan needs but nobody stated, and lets DDA explain the assumptions, each explanation becoming a sub-goal, up to a depth bound. The tools use a SROIQ reasoner only through a small contract, so they depend neither on a particular reasoner nor on a particular data structure; they are designed for a reasoner that processes added and removed axioms incrementally. Change is treated without modal operators, on one linear timeline and without possible worlds, so decidability of projection follows from that of SROIQ. We prove that indirect effects are exactly the entailments of the updated state, that DDA and APT are sound and terminate, and that bounded planning is 2NExpTime-hard and in 3ExpTime. We compare the tools with hitting-set abduction, the solver CATS and classical planning, and run them on six benchmarks and five reasoners with identical results.

AI.title_translation: 时序动态知识图谱上的交替溯因与规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对时序动态知识图谱的交替溯因与规划框架（APT及DDA），在单一时间线下结合增量SROIQ推理实现了可靠、可终止的目标规划与解释。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱随时间动态变化，动作产生的效果常未完全列明，本体会引发间接后果，动作所需事实常处于未知状态，且动作可能导致图谱不一致，因而需要在时序动态环境中解决状态投影、溯因与规划问题。
AI.method: 提出了三个工具：（1）时序投影，用于精确测试规划；（2）直接推导溯因（DDA），通过假设观察的否定并对其新推导结果取反来解释观察；（3）APT算法，从目标向后规划，假设缺失事实并用DDA解释以生成子目标（达至深度限制）。该框架基于单一线性时间线、无模态算子，仅通过轻量级契约调用SROIQ增量推理机。
AI.result: 理论上证明了间接效果即为更新状态的蕴涵、DDA与APT具有可靠性并可终止，确定了有界规划的复杂度为2NExpTime-hard且在3ExpTime内；实验上在6个基准测试和5个推理机上获得了与击中集溯因、CATS求解器及经典规划系统一致的结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了针对时序动态知识图谱的形式化推理与规划框架，证明了其逻辑可靠性与终止性，并通过实验验证了其跨多个推理机和基准的通用有效性。
AI.translation: 知识图谱随时间演化，但动作对它们产生的影响通常仅被部分说明：本体会引发更进一步的推论，动作所需的事实往往未知，且动作可能导致图谱出现不一致。我们针对时序动态知识图谱（TDKG）研究了这些问题，TDKG即动作为带有删除/插入模板的规则且事件位于内在时间线上的SROIQ知识库。我们提出了三种工具：时序投影（用于规划的精确测试）；直接推导溯因（DDA，通过假设观察的否定并取反推理机新推导出的内容来解释观察）；以及APT（TDKG上的溯因与规划，从目标向后规划，假设规划所需但未被说明的事实，并利用DDA解释这些假设，在深度限制内将每个解释转化为子目标）。这些工具仅通过轻量级契约调用SROIQ推理机，因此既不依赖于特定推理机，也不依赖于特定数据结构；它们专为能够增量处理添加与删除公理的推理机而设计。状态变化在单一线性时间线上处理，不使用模态算子和可能世界，因此投影的可判定性直接沿袭自SROIQ。我们证明了间接效果正是更新状态的蕴涵，DDA和APT是可靠且可终止的，并且有界规划是2NExpTime-hard且属于3ExpTime。我们将这些工具与击中集溯因、CATS求解器及经典规划进行了对比，并在六个基准和五个推理机上运行，获得了相同的结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于SROIQ的时序动态知识图谱（TDKG），提出了一套将溯因推理与规划交替进行的框架。该框架包含时序投影、直接推导溯因（DDA）以及交替溯因规划算法（APT），在无需模态算子的单线性时间线上实现了可靠且可终止的有界规划，并通过轻量级契约无缝适配各类增量本体推理机。
AI.keywords: 时序动态知识图谱, 溯因推理, 自动规划, SROIQ, 描述逻辑
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将描述逻辑（SROIQ）本体推理与溯因推理、时序规划解耦并有机结合，避免了复杂的模态算子与可能世界语义，保证了投影的可判定性。其通过模块化契约设计支持任意增量推理机，具有极高的通用性和严格的理论保证（可靠性与终止性）。潜在局限在于有界规划的计算复杂度较高（2NExpTime-hard至3ExpTime），大规模动态场景下的实时性可能面临挑战。

title: LLM Misuse Safeguards Rely on Untrusted Input: A Widespread, High-Risk Vulnerability
comments: 13 pages, 4 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Large language models now help professionals in fields such as cybersecurity and biology, yet the same answers would help an attacker. Deployers rely on misuse safeguards to keep such answers from attackers. We find that these safeguards share a high-risk vulnerability: they decide whether to release an answer from what users write, including the professional identity or purpose they claim, and anyone can write such a claim. Threat reports from model vendors and security firms show that attackers who fabricate a professional identity or purpose already exploit this vulnerability to cause serious harm. The vulnerability is also widespread across the state of the art: every defense proposed in 129 papers from the latest editions of 12 top venues has it. Safeguard research studies the wrong object: it treats harm as a property of the text of a request, although the same text can come from a professional or an attacker. Current safeguard benchmarks therefore cannot reveal the vulnerability: a safeguard can score high on them and still give dangerous answers to attackers. Because the vulnerability lies in what users write, no improvement in how safeguards judge that writing can close it. Under the patch we propose, large language models can help professionals without giving dangerous capabilities to anyone who merely claims to be one.
comment: 13 pages, 4 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

AI.title_translation: LLM防滥用安全机制依赖不可信输入：一个普遍存在的高危漏洞
AI.tldr: 现有LLM安全防御仅根据用户自称的身份和意图做判断，导致所有现有防御均存在严重漏洞且易被攻击者伪造身份绕过。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在网络安全和生物等领域的双重用途特性使得其回答既能帮助专业人员也能被攻击者利用，而现存的安全防护机制依赖于用户自称的职业身份或用途（不可信输入）来决定是否提供回答，攻击者可轻易伪造身份绕过防护。
AI.method: 通过审查模型供应商和安全公司的威胁情报报告，系统分析了12顶会最新发表的129篇安全防御论文中的前沿防御方案，并提出了一种使LLM在不赋予冒充者危险能力的前提下协助专业人员的新型补丁方案（具体技术细节摘要未详述）。
AI.result: 威胁报告显示攻击者已在利用伪造身份/意图来引发严重危害；调研的12个顶级会议最新一届的129篇论文中所提出的所有防御方法均存在此漏洞；现有基准测试由于将危害性视作请求文本的内在属性，无法揭示此类高风险漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 由于该漏洞本质在于依赖用户不可信的输入文本，因此无论如何改进文本层面的安全判断算法都无法彻底修复它；必须打破仅基于请求文本进行安全决策的传统范式，通过新的防御补丁机制将危险能力与未经验证的用户身份隔离开来。
AI.translation: 大语言模型如今在网络安全和生物学等领域为专业人士提供帮助，然而同样的回答也会对攻击者有所助益。部署方依赖防滥用安全机制来防止攻击者获取这些回答。我们发现这些安全机制存在一个共同的高危漏洞：它们根据用户所写的内容（包括用户自称的专业身份或目的）来决定是否给出回答，而任何人都可以编写此类声明。来自模型供应商和安全公司的威胁报告表明，伪造专业身份或目的的攻击者已经在利用该漏洞造成严重危害。该漏洞在最先进的研究中也普遍存在：来自12个顶级会议最新一届论文中所提出的全部129种防御方法都存在该漏洞。安全机制研究关注了错误的对象：它将危害视为请求文本本身的一种属性，尽管相同的文本既可能来自专业人士，也可能来自攻击者。因此，现有的安全机制基准无法揭示该漏洞——一个安全机制可以在基准测试中获得高分，却仍会将危险回答提供给攻击者。由于该漏洞源于用户所写的内容，因此在安全机制如何研判文本方面无论做何改进都无法弥合该漏洞。在我们提出的补丁方案下，大语言模型可以在不给仅仅自称是专业人士的任何人提供危险能力的前提下，为真正的专业人士提供帮助。
AI.summary: 本文揭示了大语言模型防滥用安全机制中普遍存在的高危漏洞：现有系统完全依赖用户在请求中所自称的身份或目的来决定是否放行回答，这属于不可信输入。研究发现，顶级会议上提出的129种现有防御方案均存在该漏洞，且已被攻击者实际利用。现行将危害视为文本固有属性的基准无法反映该问题，且仅靠改进文本判别无法解决。作者据此指出当前研究方向的误区并提出了相应的修复补丁。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型滥用, 安全防护机制, 不可信输入, 身份冒用, 双重用途风险
AI.comments: 该论文敏锐地指出了当前大语言模型安全防御机制中的根本性范式缺陷：将“请求文本是否具有害性”作为判断标准，却忽视了相同的双重用途文本在专业人士与攻击者手中的巨大差异。这一研究从根本上质疑了现存129篇前沿安全防御论文与基准测试的有效性，强调安全防线不能仅依赖不可信的提示词输入，对于推动大模型安全访问控制体系（如引入身份认证与权限隔离）具有重要的警示与指导意义。

title: RaDiVe: Robust 4D Radar Odometry with Distance-Bounded NDT and Velocity-Discrepancy Point Uncertainty
summary: Recent advances in 4D radar enable robust perception in adverse weather; however, the inherent sparsity, noise, and limited positional precision of radar point clouds pose significant challenges for registration-based odometry. In this letter, we propose RaDiVe, a 4D radar odometry framework that improves the accuracy and robustness of radar point cloud registration. We introduce a distance-bounded Normal Distributions Transform, which improves optimization stability and computational efficiency by restricting the correspondence search to near-distance voxel pairs. To mitigate measurement ambiguity, we propose a velocity-discrepancy point uncertainty model that weights each input 4D radar point according to the discrepancy between its measured Doppler radial velocity and the radial velocity predicted from the estimated ego-velocity. We also incorporate Signed Distance Function-based surface point extraction via implicit neural mapping to construct a geometrically consistent, noise-filtered local submap. Evaluations across multiple public datasets demonstrate that RaDiVe outperforms existing 4D radar odometry baselines by 44.4% in translational and 21.3% in rotational Absolute Trajectory Error on average, while maintaining real-time performance.

AI.title_translation: RaDiVe：基于距离受限NDT与速度差异点不确定性的鲁棒4D雷达里程计
AI.tldr: RaDiVe通过距离受限NDT、多普勒速度差异加权及神经SDF表面提取，实现了高精度、抗噪且实时的4D雷达里程计。
AI.motivation: 4D雷达在恶劣天气下具备鲁棒感知能力，但其点云固有的稀疏性、噪声以及有限的位置精度给基于配准的雷达里程计带来了巨大挑战。
AI.method: 1. 提出距离受限的正态分布变换（NDT），通过将对应点搜索限制在近距离体素对中，提升优化稳定性和计算效率；2. 提出基于速度差异的点不确定性模型，根据测量多普勒径向速度与由估计自身车速预测出的径向速度之间的偏差对雷达点进行加权；3. 结合基于隐式神经建图的有符号距离函数（SDF）表面点提取，构建几何一致且滤除噪声的局部子图。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上的评估表明，RaDiVe在保持实时性能的前提下，相比现有4D雷达里程计基准方法，绝对轨迹误差（ATE）在平移和旋转上分别平均降低了44.4%和21.3%。
AI.conclusion: RaDiVe在保证实时性的同时，显著提升了4D雷达里程计在恶劣感知条件下的配准鲁棒性与位姿估计精度。
AI.translation: 4D雷达的最新进展使其能够在恶劣天气下实现鲁棒感知；然而，雷达点云固有的稀疏性、噪声以及有限的位置精度对基于配准的里程计构成了重大挑战。在本文中，我们提出了RaDiVe，一种用于提升雷达点云配准精度和鲁棒性的4D雷达里程计框架。我们引入了一种距离受限的正态分布变换（NDT），通过将对应搜索限制在近距离体素对中，从而提高了优化稳定性和计算效率。为了减轻测量模糊性，我们提出了一种速度差异点不确定性模型，该模型根据测量的多普勒径向速度与根据估计的自身速度预测的径向速度之间的差异对每个输入的4D雷达点赋予权重。我们还结合了通过隐式神经建图提取基于有符号距离函数（SDF）的表面点，以构建几何一致且经过噪声滤波的局部子图。在多个公开数据集上的评估表明，RaDiVe在保持实时性能的同时，在平移和旋转绝对轨迹误差上平均比现有4D雷达里程计基准分别优异44.4%和21.3%。
AI.summary: 针对4D雷达点云稀疏、噪声大和位置精度低的难题，本文提出了RaDiVe里程计框架。该方法融合了距离受限NDT配准、基于多普勒速度差异的点不确定性加权以及基于隐式神经SDF的去噪表面提取技术，在多个公开基准上实现了显著优于现有方法的精度，且具备实时运行能力。
AI.keywords: 4D毫米波雷达, 雷达里程计, 正态分布变换 (NDT), 多普勒速度, 隐式神经建图
AI.comments: 该论文针对4D毫米波雷达固有的稀疏、高噪声以及测距/测角精度不足等痛点，创新性地将多普勒速度一致性引入点不确定度建模，并结合距离受限NDT与隐式神经SDF建图，不仅显著提升了配准精度和轨迹估计表现，还兼顾了实时性，为恶劣天气下的鲁棒定位提供了极具实用价值的解决方案。

title: RecHarness: A Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
summary: Optimizing recommender models remains heavily reliant on manual iteration over architectures, objectives, and training strategies. While LLM-based agents can automate this trial-and-error process, relying on LLMs to both select modification directions and formulate concrete hypotheses can lead to unstable search under limited trial budgets. Inspired by the above challenge, we propose RecHarness, a Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for automated recommender model optimization. RecHarness decouples the optimization process into two steps: a bandit router selects the next modification direction according to historical validation feedback, while the LLM generates a concrete optimization hypothesis and executable code edit within the selected direction. To sustain long-horizon exploration, RecHarness uses a jump-basin mechanism to activate a structural-jump arm when local edits stagnate. Across multiple recommendation tasks, datasets, and model backbones, RecHarness achieves more consistent performance improvements and uses limited trial budgets more effectively than LLM-directed search. During a 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale short-video advertising platform, the selected candidate improves ADVV by 2.084%, Revenue by 0.534%, and Exposure by 0.559%. Code is available at: https://github.com/6lyc/RecHarness.

AI.title_translation: RecHarness：面向自进化推荐系统的老虎机路由智能体框架
AI.tldr: RecHarness通过多臂老虎机路由与大语言模型代码生成的解耦协作，实现了预算受限下推荐模型的高效、稳定自动化自进化优化。
AI.motivation: 推荐模型的优化高度依赖人工反复试错调整架构、目标和训练策略。虽然大语言模型智能体可用于自动化此过程，但在有限的试验预算下，若让大模型同时承担“选择修改方向”与“构建具体假设”双重任务，会导致搜索极不稳定。
AI.method: 提出RecHarness框架，将优化过程解耦为两步：首先由多臂老虎机（Bandit）路由器根据历史验证集反馈选择下一步的修改方向；随后LLM在指定方向内生成具体的优化假设与可执行代码修改。此外，框架设计了“跳跃盆地（jump-basin）”机制，在局部优化停滞时触发结构跳跃臂以保持长程探索能力。
AI.result: 在多种推荐任务、数据集和骨干模型上的离线实验表明，RecHarness相比纯LLM引导的搜索实现了更一致的性能提升，且显著提高了试验预算的利用效率；在大型短视频广告平台开展的7天在线A/B测试中，所选候选模型带来了ADVV提升2.084%、收入提升0.534%、曝光量提升0.559%的显著增益。
AI.conclusion: RecHarness通过将方向探索（老虎机路由）与具体实现（大模型生成）相解耦，并结合跳跃盆地机制，有效解决了自动化推荐模型搜索过程中的不稳定与预算低效问题，在线上线下实验中均验证了其驱动推荐系统自进化优化的显著效果。
AI.translation: 推荐模型的优化仍然严重依赖于对架构、目标和训练策略的人工迭代。尽管基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体可以使这种试错过程自动化，但在有限的试验预算下，依赖LLM同时选择修改方向并提出具体假设会导致搜索不稳定。受此挑战启发，我们提出了RecHarness，一种用于自动化推荐模型优化的老虎机路由智能体框架。RecHarness将优化过程解耦为两步：老虎机路由器根据历史验证反馈选择下一个修改方向，而LLM则在选定方向内生成具体的优化假设和可执行的代码修改。为了维持长程探索，RecHarness采用跳跃盆地机制，在局部编辑陷入停滞时激活结构化跳跃臂。在多个推荐任务、数据集和模型骨干上，RecHarness相比LLM直接引导的搜索实现了更一致的性能提升，且更有效地利用了有限的试验预算。在大型短视频广告平台进行的为期7天的在线A/B测试中，所选候选模型使ADVV提升了2.084%，收入提升了0.534%，曝光量提升了0.559%。代码开源于：https://github.com/6lyc/RecHarness。
AI.summary: 针对LLM智能体在自动化优化推荐系统模型时存在的搜索不稳定与预算消耗大等问题，本文提出了RecHarness框架。该框架利用多臂老虎机基于历史反馈路由优化方向，由LLM在限定方向内生成假设与代码，并引入跳跃机制突破局部停滞。实验及真实广告场景A/B测试均验证了该方法的高效性与性能收益。
AI.keywords: 推荐系统, 大语言模型智能体, 多臂老虎机, 自动化模型优化, 自进化系统
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将传统强化学习/在线学习中的老虎机（Bandit）机制与现代大语言模型（LLM）智能体进行解耦分工，用确定性反馈驱动的Bandit决策宏观优化方向，用LLM完成微观假设推导与代码生成，有效解决了纯大模型搜索在有限预算下易发散、不稳定的痛点。同时引入跳跃盆地机制缓解局部最优问题，并在大规模真实广告业务A/B测试中取得了可观的商业指标增益，具备极高的实用价值与落地潜力。

title: A Grey Literature Review of Graduate Students' Research Practices and Skills in the LLM Era
summary:
Context: Graduate students in computing now use Large Language Models (LLMs) throughout their research, from literature reviews and coding to data analysis and writing. Yet there is little shared understanding of which skills competent use of these tools requires, so graduate programs struggle to teach, mentor, or assess it, and unverified outputs can propagate into the scientific record.
  Objective: We investigate which LLM-based practices graduate students employ in their research and which skills they need to benefit from these practices.
  Method: We conducted a grey literature review of Reddit discussions. We retrieved 1,383 posts from five research-oriented subreddits, screened them against explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria, and analyzed the 54 included posts with thematic analysis, in which two authors independently coded each excerpt.
  Results: We identified seven categories of practices and nine categories of skills. Commenters locate the problem in accepting generated output without inspection rather than in using LLMs, and warn that delegating the effortful parts of a task, such as debugging, reading, or validating sources, delivers the output without building the skill the task was meant to develop. Traditional skills, such as programming and critical thinking, are what allow students to verify what an LLM produces.
  Conclusions: Our categories give graduate programs a concrete basis to teach students to work with LLMs without eroding the skills that research training should build, and they add research-specific skills, such as data sharing and scientific reproducibility, to existing AI competency frameworks.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型时代研究生科研实践与技能的灰色文献综述
AI.tldr: 通过分析Reddit讨论发现，研究生使用LLM的关键问题在于未经核查即采用输出，研究生项目需在教授LLM应用的同时保护批判性思维等核心技能的培养。
AI.motivation: 计算机专业研究生在科研全流程中广泛使用大语言模型（LLM），但学界对其所需的核心技能缺乏共识，导致研究生项目难以进行教学、指导或评估，且未经验证的生成内容可能会渗入科学文献中。
AI.method: 对Reddit相关讨论进行了灰色文献综述。从5个科研导向的subreddit中检索了1,383个帖子，按照明确的纳入与排除标准筛选出54个帖子，并由两名作者独立编码开展主题分析。
AI.result: 识别出了7类实践和9类技能。核心问题不在于使用LLM本身，而在于未经核查直接接受生成结果；将调试、精读或验证文献等费力的环节委托给LLM虽能产出成果，但阻碍了关键能力的培养；传统的编程和批判性思维等技能依然是验证LLM输出的核心基础。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的实践与技能分类框架为研究生教育提供了具体依据，有助于指导学生在不削弱核心学术技能的前提下合理使用LLM，并为现有AI能力框架补充了数据共享和科学可复现性等科研特有技能。
AI.translation:
背景：计算机专业的研究生目前在文献综述、编程、数据分析和论文写作等整个研究过程中广泛使用大语言模型（LLM）。然而，对于胜任使用这些工具需要哪些技能，目前尚缺乏共识，这导致研究生培养项目难以对此进行教学、指导或评估，且未经验证的输出可能会流入科学记录中。
目的：我们调查了研究生在科研中采用了哪些基于LLM的实践，以及他们需要哪些技能才能从这些实践中获益。
方法：我们对Reddit上的讨论进行了灰色文献综述。我们从五个以研究为导向的子版块中检索了1,383个帖子，根据明确的纳入和排除标准进行筛选，并使用主题分析法分析了最终纳入的54个帖子，由两名作者对每个摘录进行了独立编码。
结果：我们确定了7类实践和9类技能。评论者认为问题不在于使用LLM，而在于未经检查就接受生成的内容；同时警告称，将任务中费力的部分（如调试、阅读或验证来源）委托给LLM，虽能交付成果，但无法培养该任务原本旨在提升的技能。传统的技能（如编程和批判性思维）才是让学生能够验证LLM生成内容的基础。
结论：我们的分类框架为研究生培养项目提供了一个具体的基础，以便在不削弱科研训练应培养的技能的前提下，指导学生与LLM协同工作，并为现有的AI能力框架增加了诸如数据共享和科学可复现性等科研特有的技能。
AI.summary: 本文针对大模型时代计算机专业研究生科研技能与规范缺失的问题，通过对Reddit科研板块的灰色文献展开主题分析，梳理了7类科研实践和9类必备技能，强调了核心基础能力在验证模型输出中的重要性，并为研究生AI培养框架提供了建设性指导。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 研究生科研实践, 灰色文献综述, 科研技能, 批判性思维
AI.comments: 本研究创新性地采用灰文献（Reddit社区讨论）来捕捉研究生使用大模型开展科研的真实生态与痛点。研究敏锐地指出，过度依赖LLM完成耗费精力的任务会导致学生核心科研能力缺失，强调了传统学术基础能力（如批判性思维和编程基础）在验证LLM生成结果中的关键作用，对当前研究生培养体系改革具有重要的参考价值。其局限性在于数据样本来源于特定社交平台，可能存在一定的自选择偏差。

title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
comments: 34 pages. Published at the Social Sim'26 Workshop, COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors
summary: Social simulations built from language-model agents need role-conditioned behavior that can be checked before agents are placed into a simulated population. We introduce an activation-steering screening workflow for role-conditioned agents: define a role profile, extract a role-specific direction, sweep four steering coefficients, evaluate role-profile alignment, and pass or flag each candidate configuration. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, we apply the workflow to a mixed 275-role inventory with 228 role-agnostic questions, GPT-4.1-mini prompted role references, and GPT-4.1-mini judges. We also introduce CastVectors, which receive higher judged role-profile alignment than an assistant-axis directional control from prior persona-vector work, with mean overall scores of 63.2 versus 41.1 across the tested grid. They also preserve high lexical diversity, while the control drops sharply at larger coefficients. The role-level screen is the main contribution: most roles improve as steering increases, but 38 roles decline across all six measured dimensions, showing why simulation builders should choose coefficients per role rather than deploy a uniform high-strength setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors, and the role vectors and evaluation data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors.
comment: 34 pages. Published at the Social Sim'26 Workshop, COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors

AI.title_translation: 面向社会模拟的语言模型角色引导
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于激活引导（CastVectors）的角色筛选工作流，证实了针对不同模拟角色独立挑选引导系数而非统一设置强度的必要性。
AI.motivation: 由语言模型智能体构建的社会模拟需要受角色约束的行为，且这种行为需要在智能体被放入模拟群体之前能够进行验证和筛选。
AI.method: 提出了一个针对角色条件智能体的激活引导筛选工作流：1. 定义角色画像；2. 提取特定角色的引导方向（命名为 CastVectors）；3. 遍历扫描四个引导系数；4. 评估其与角色画像的对齐程度；5. 判定通过或标记各个候选配置。在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 上结合 275 个角色清单、228 个问题以及基于 GPT-4.1-mini 的参考与裁判机制进行了验证。
AI.result: CastVectors 相比先前的角色向量助手轴基准取得了更高的角色画像对齐得分（平均 63.2 分对比 41.1 分），并在较大系数下依然保持了高词汇多样性；多数角色随引导强度增加表现提升，但发现有 38 个角色在所有六个评测维度上均出现退化。
AI.conclusion: 社会模拟构建者在部署角色智能体时，应当根据每个角色的具体评估表现针对性地选择引导系数，而不是采用统一的高强度引导配置。
AI.translation: 由语言模型智能体构建的社会模拟需要角色条件化的行为，并且这种行为在智能体被放入模拟人群之前应当是可检验的。我们介绍了一种用于角色条件智能体的激活引导筛选工作流程：定义角色画像、提取角色特定方向、扫描四个引导系数、评估与角色画像的对齐程度，并对每个候选配置进行通过或标记。在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 上，我们将该工作流程应用于包含 275 个角色的混合清单，并结合了 228 个角色无关问题、由 GPT-4.1-mini 提示生成的角色参考以及 GPT-4.1-mini 裁判。我们还提出了 CastVectors，它获得了比以往人设向量工作中助手轴向控制更高的角色画像对齐评估分（在测试网格上的平均总分为 63.2，而对照组为 41.1）。它们还保持了较高的词汇多样性，而对照组在较大系数下词汇多样性急剧下降。角色级筛选是本文的主要贡献：大多数角色随着引导强度的增加而改善，但在所有六个衡量维度上，有 38 个角色的表现均出现下滑，这表明模拟构建者应按角色单独选择系数，而非部署统一的高强度设置。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors 获取，角色向量和评估数据可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对社会模拟中语言模型智能体的角色设定需求，提出了基于激活引导的角色筛选工作流及 CastVectors 角色引导方向。实验表明，CastVectors 在角色对齐度和词汇多样性上均显著优于以往方法；同时研究指出不同角色对引导强度的响应存在差异，强调了因角色而异调整引导参数的重要性。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 角色引导, 激活引导, 社会模拟, 智能体
AI.comments: 该研究的核心创新在于将激活引导（activation steering）应用于多智能体社会模拟的角色塑造中，并提出了细粒度的角色筛选与验证工作流程。研究揭示了一个关键现象：统一的高强度引导对某些角色反而会产生负面影响，强调了针对不同角色个性化调优引导系数的必要性。局限性在于主要依赖于单一开源模型（OLMo-3-7B-Instruct）和基于大模型裁判（GPT-4.1-mini）的评估体系，其在复杂交互模拟中的长期稳定性和泛化性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Dynamic Flexibility Requests in Local Flexibility Markets: Quantifying the DSO Willingness to Pay
summary: Local Flexibility Markets (LFMs) require Distribution System Operators (DSOs) to determine both the quantity of flexibility to procure and the corresponding willingness to pay during market clearing. Existing approaches typically rely on centralized AC-OPF clearing algorithms with limited practical scalability or strictly localized, static flexibility requests driven primarily by congestion management, while the economic value of flexibility is largely neglected. This paper proposes a dynamic flexibility-request methodology in which the DSO's willingness to pay is embedded directly into the market-clearing objective by monetizing transformer and cable aging, network losses, and voltage congestion. To enable computationally efficient clearing, exact convex piecewise-linear epigraph reformulations of the IEEE C57.91 transformer aging model and an Arrhenius-based cable aging model are developed and formally proven to preserve exactness. The proposed framework is validated on a modified CIGRE MV benchmark and compared with a recent state-of-the-art flexibility-request methodology. The results demonstrate significantly higher market liquidity, more efficient flexibility procurement, and improved network operations while preserving the market's transparency and non-discrimination principles.

AI.title_translation: 地方灵活性市场中的动态灵活性需求：量化配电系统运营商的支付意愿
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动态灵活性需求方法，通过将配电系统运营商（DSO）的支付意愿与变压器和电缆老化、网络损耗及电压拥塞的货币化价值相结合，以提高地方灵活性市场的效率和电网运行水平。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在地方灵活性市场中，配电系统运营商（DSO）确定灵活性采购数量和支付意愿时，存在可扩展性限制，主要依赖于局部的静态需求管理，且大多忽视了灵活性的经济价值。
AI.method: 提出了一种动态灵活性需求方法。该方法通过将变压器和电缆老化、网络损耗以及电压拥塞货币化，将DSO的支付意愿直接嵌入到市场出清目标中。为提高计算效率，开发并证明了IEEE C57.91变压器老化模型和基于Arrhenius的电缆老化模型的精确凸分段线性上图重构。
AI.result: 结果表明，该方法显著提高了市场流动性，实现了更高效的灵活性采购，并改善了电网运行，同时保持了市场的透明度和非歧视原则。
AI.conclusion: 通过将DSO的支付意愿动态嵌入市场出清，并考虑网络设备老化等经济价值，可以显著提升地方灵活性市场的效率和电网运行水平。
AI.translation: 地方灵活性市场（LFMs）要求配电系统运营商（DSOs）在市场出清过程中确定灵活性采购的数量和相应的支付意愿。现有方法通常依赖于集中式交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）出清算法，但其实际可扩展性有限，或者依赖于主要由拥塞管理驱动的严格局部化、静态的灵活性需求，而灵活性的经济价值在很大程度上被忽视。本文提出了一种动态灵活性需求方法，其中DSO的支付意愿通过将变压器和电缆老化、网络损耗以及电压拥塞货币化，直接嵌入到市场出清目标中。为了实现计算高效的出清，本文开发并正式证明了IEEE C57.91变压器老化模型和基于Arrhenius的电缆老化模型的精确凸分段线性上图重构，以保持其精确性。所提出的框架在修改后的CIGRE中压基准模型上进行了验证，并与近期最先进的灵活性需求方法进行了比较。结果表明，该方法显著提高了市场流动性，实现了更高效的灵活性采购，并改善了电网运行，同时保持了市场的透明度和非歧视原则。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的动态灵活性需求方法，旨在解决地方灵活性市场中配电系统运营商（DSO）在确定灵活性采购量和支付意愿时面临的挑战。该方法通过量化变压器和电缆老化、网络损耗及电压拥塞的经济价值，将DSO的支付意愿直接整合到市场出清目标中。为确保计算效率，研究开发了精确的凸分段线性重构模型。实验结果表明，该方法能显著提高市场流动性、采购效率和电网运行性能，同时维护市场公平性。
AI.keywords: 地方灵活性市场, 配电系统运营商, 动态灵活性需求, 支付意愿, 网络老化
AI.comments: 这项工作通过将DSO的支付意愿与具体的网络经济影响（如设备老化和损耗）相结合，提供了一种更精细、更经济高效的灵活性采购机制。其创新之处在于将复杂的物理模型（如老化模型）转换为可用于市场出清的计算高效形式，这对于提高地方灵活性市场的实用性和效率具有重要意义。

title: The Nuclear Decision-Making Benchmark: Evaluating Frontier LLM Tendencies in Escalation, Proliferation, Non-Proliferation, and Arms Control Scenarios
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are entering defense and national-security workflows. Seven of the nine nuclear-armed states have committed to keeping humans in control of decisions to use nuclear weapons, but LLMs may still shape the assessments and options that reach decision-makers. Scrutinizing that influence calls for evidence about how these models behave on nuclear-policy questions. Such evidence should cover more than crisis escalation and should separate a model's tendencies from artifacts of a single phrasing, ordering, or run; evaluations to date have not focused on these questions. We introduce the Nuclear Decision-Making Benchmark (NDM Bench), a dataset and reproducible framework for testing how the choice of model and the design of a question shape LLMs' answers on nuclear policy. Its 151 scenarios, written by international relations experts, span four domains: nuclear escalation (76), arms control (25), non-proliferation (25), and proliferation (25). Each scenario can be posed with different states in the decision-maker's role and with added framing sentences. Eight frontier LLMs answered every prompt five times, about 380{,}000 responses in all. Results highlight that models' choices differ by model and domain, and that in escalation, how often they choose a nuclear threat or nuclear use depends on the state being advised and, for some models, the framing. However, agreement across identical runs is often low, with all five runs agreeing on only 43\% of escalation prompts. We release the scenarios, the prompts with their answer orders, and the parsed responses, along with documentation of how they were built and recommended practices for evaluations where there is no correct answer to grade against.

AI.title_translation: 核决策基准：评估前沿大型语言模型在升级、扩散、不扩散和军备控制情景中的倾向
AI.tldr: 研究引入了“核决策基准（NDM Bench）”数据集和框架，用于评估前沿LLM在核政策问题上的行为倾向，发现模型选择因模型、领域和情景设置而异，且运行一致性较低。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）正进入国防和国家安全领域，可能影响核武器决策。然而，现有评估未能充分关注LLM在核政策问题上的行为，特别是其在不同情景和表述下的倾向。为了审视LLM的这种潜在影响，需要更全面的证据。
AI.method: 引入了核决策基准（NDM Bench），一个包含151个由国际关系专家编写的场景的数据集和可复现框架。这些场景涵盖核升级、军备控制、不扩散和扩散四个领域。通过让八个前沿LLM对每个提示回答五次（总计约38万个响应）进行测试，评估模型选择和问题设计如何影响LLMs在核政策上的回答。
AI.result: 模型选择因模型和领域而异。在核升级情景中，LLM选择核威胁或核使用的频率取决于被建议的国家以及（对某些模型而言）情景框架。然而，相同运行之间的一致性通常较低，在核升级提示中，所有五次运行仅有43%的同意度。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在核决策中的行为复杂且多变，受模型、领域、情景设置和国家角色影响，并且其内部一致性不足。这凸显了在将LLMs应用于国家安全领域时需要谨慎，并为未来的评估提供了工具和实践建议。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）正在进入国防和国家安全工作流程。九个核武器国家中有七个已承诺将核武器使用决策权保留在人类手中，但LLM仍可能影响到达决策者的评估和选项。审视这种影响需要证据来证明这些模型在核政策问题上的行为方式。此类证据应涵盖危机升级之外的范围，并应将模型的倾向与单一措辞、排序或运行的假象区分开来；迄今为止的评估尚未关注这些问题。我们引入了核决策基准（NDM Bench），这是一个数据集和可复现的框架，用于测试模型选择和问题设计如何塑造LLM在核政策上的回答。其151个情景由国际关系专家撰写，涵盖四个领域：核升级（76个）、军备控制（25个）、不扩散（25个）和扩散（25个）。每个情景都可以由不同国家扮演决策者角色，并添加框架语句。八个前沿LLM对每个提示回答了五次，总计约38万个响应。结果强调，模型的选择因模型和领域而异，在升级情景中，它们选择核威胁或核使用的频率取决于被建议的国家，对于某些模型，还取决于框架。然而，相同运行之间的一致性通常较低，所有五次运行仅在43%的升级提示上达成一致。我们发布了情景、带有答案顺序的提示以及解析后的响应，以及它们是如何构建的文档和在没有正确答案可供评分的情况下进行评估的推荐实践。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了核决策基准（NDM Bench），一个用于评估前沿大型语言模型（LLM）在核政策问题上行为倾向的数据集和可复现框架。该基准包含由国际关系专家编写的151个情景，涵盖核升级、军备控制、不扩散和扩散等领域。通过对八个前沿LLM进行大规模测试（约38万次响应），研究发现LLM的选择因模型、领域和情景设置而异，尤其是在核升级情景中，其倾向受被建议国家和情景框架影响。此外，相同运行之间的一致性较低。研究发布了数据集和评估实践建议，旨在为LLM在国家安全领域的应用提供更深入的理解和更严谨的评估方法。
AI.keywords: 核决策, 大型语言模型, 国家安全, 军备控制, 核升级
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入“核决策基准”为评估LLM在敏感国家安全领域的行为提供了一个创新且重要的框架。其大规模、多情景、多模型的测试方法揭示了LLM在核政策决策中存在的复杂性和不稳定性，特别是其对情景设置和国家角色的敏感性以及运行结果的低一致性。这对于理解LLM在实际应用中可能带来的风险至关重要，并强调了在将其集成到关键决策流程之前进行严格、多维度评估的必要性。该工作也为未来LLM在无标准答案领域的评估提供了宝贵的资源和实践指导。

title: StyleComposer: Training-Free Multi-Reference Style Composition
summary: The color, texture, and structure of an image can come from different references, but reference-guided generators transfer each reference as a single style signal. We find that in a diffusion transformer, every pathway that brings in a reference transfers multiple attributes, yet each attribute has one representation in which it is most directly controllable. Guided by this finding, we design StyleComposer to route color through the chromatic coordinates of the latent, texture through the attention keys and values, and structure through the queries, and to limit what else each route admits from its reference. Without training or inversion, StyleComposer follows the references and the prompt together more closely than stylization methods and multi-image generators, and it sets the strength of each attribute separately.

title: MAGIC-SSCIL: Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration for Semi-Supervised Class Incremental Learning
comments: v2: substantially revised. The method is simplified (Geometric Structural Alignment, manifold mixup, warm-up and variance shrinkage are removed), all MAGIC experiments are new (five seeds), the TACLE baseline numbers are corrected, and new analyses of pseudo-label accuracy, class statistics and ablations are added. 52 pages
summary: Exemplar-free semi-supervised class-incremental learning (SSCIL) asks a model to learn new classes from a few labeled and many unlabeled images without storing past data. A common recipe replays old classes from stored Gaussian statistics and pseudo-labels unlabeled data with a confidence threshold. With one or two labels per class, however, the model's confidence is a poor guide to which pseudo-labels are right, so the statistics that replay depends on rest on few or noisy samples. We propose MAGIC (Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration), which propagates labels over a k-nearest-neighbor graph of frozen features and uses the propagated confidences as weights in the unlabeled loss and, through Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC), in the class statistics from which phantom features replay old classes. With a frozen ResNet-18 on CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R at 1%, 5%, and 10% labels, we compare MAGIC with nine supervised class-incremental methods equipped with FixMatch and two native SSCIL methods. MAGIC gains from unlabeled data in all nine settings, most at 1%, and leads on fine-grained CUB-200 at every ratio; at 1% it is level with the best on ImageNet-R and 2.2 points behind the native SSCIL method TACLE on CIFAR-100. Experiments inside MAGIC show that most of this gain flows through the weighted statistics, not the loss, that at 1% labels graph pseudo-labels are more accurate than the model's own at equal coverage, and that a fixed threshold of 0.95 removes most of the gain. At higher ratios, baselines that adapt the backbone or model full covariances overtake MAGIC on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-R.
comment: v2: substantially revised. The method is simplified (Geometric Structural Alignment, manifold mixup, warm-up and variance shrinkage are removed), all MAGIC experiments are new (five seeds), the TACLE baseline numbers are corrected, and new analyses of pseudo-label accuracy, class statistics and ablations are added. 52 pages

title: Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: A Benchmark for VLM Readiness in Safety-Critical Scenarios
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are often deployed as embodied controllers for robotics, yet it remains unclear how well they can explore an environment, maintain an internal map, and ground safety-critical decisions in long-horizon sequential trajectories. In this work, we introduce EMRD, an evaluation framework that decouples spatial reasoning into four stages: Explore (what the agent observes), Map (what it records and where), Remember (what it retains), and Decide (whether its final choice is justified), scored across 18 stage-specific metrics. We use EMRD to evaluate eleven open- and closed-weight VLMs across 16 buildings under nominal conditions and three environmental stresses (darkness, smoke, and motion noise), where an embodied VLM explores unknown rooms, maps observed objects, and selects the safest gathering place. Open-weight models leave rooms unvisited in 95% of episodes and detect at most 51% of objects; closed-weight models explore more, though with an external memory (notepad), two of the three stop prematurely. Without external memory, most VLMs keep fewer of the objects they saw, especially in larger buildings. The start limits which rooms are explored, and open-weight models started in different rooms agree on the final room not significantly more often than chance. Moreover, these choices are biased by semantic priors: swapping a room's label is often enough to change the final choice. Finally, motion noise increases object position error (by 12-60% for closed-weight models), strong darkness lowers map recall by 28-31 percentage points, and dense smoke reduces seen objects by 25-39 points, while the choice among the rooms entered does not change significantly.

AI.title_translation: 探索、建图、记忆、决策：面向安全关键场景的VLM就绪性基准
AI.tldr: EMRD是一个评估VLM在安全关键场景中探索、建图、记忆和决策能力的框架，研究发现现有VLM在探索、物体检测和记忆方面表现不佳，且易受环境压力和语义先验的影响。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）常被用作机器人领域的具身控制器，但它们在探索环境、维护内部地图以及在长序列轨迹中做出安全关键决策方面的能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 引入EMRD评估框架，将空间推理解耦为探索、建图、记忆和决策四个阶段，并使用18个阶段特定指标进行评分。该框架用于评估11个开源和闭源VLM在16个建筑中，在正常条件和三种环境压力（黑暗、烟雾、运动噪声）下的表现，任务是探索未知房间、绘制观察到的物体并选择最安全的聚集地。
AI.result: 开源模型在95%的实验中未能访问所有房间，最多只能检测到51%的物体；闭源模型探索更多，但有外部记忆（记事本）时，其中两个提前停止。没有外部记忆时，大多数VLM保留的物体更少，尤其是在大型建筑中。起始位置限制了探索的房间，开源模型在不同房间开始时，最终房间选择的一致性不比随机选择高。选择受语义先验的影响：交换房间标签常足以改变最终选择。运动噪声使闭源模型的物体位置误差增加12-60%；强黑暗使地图召回率降低28-31个百分点；浓烟使可见物体减少25-39个百分点，而进入房间的选择没有显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM在安全关键场景中的探索、建图、记忆和决策能力存在显著局限性，特别是在环境压力下和需要长程空间推理时。语义先验对决策有偏见性影响。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）常被部署为机器人领域的具身控制器，然而，它们在探索环境、维护内部地图以及在长序列轨迹中做出安全关键决策方面的能力尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们引入了EMRD，这是一个评估框架，它将空间推理解耦为四个阶段：探索（代理观察到的内容）、建图（它记录了什么以及在哪里）、记忆（它保留了什么）和决策（其最终选择是否合理），并根据18个阶段特定指标进行评分。我们使用EMRD评估了11个开源和闭源VLM在16个建筑中，在正常条件和三种环境压力（黑暗、烟雾和运动噪声）下的表现，其中具身VLM探索未知房间，绘制观察到的物体，并选择最安全的聚集地。开源模型在95%的实验中未能访问所有房间，最多只能检测到51%的物体；闭源模型探索更多，尽管有外部记忆（记事本），但其中两个提前停止。如果没有外部记忆，大多数VLM保留的物体更少，尤其是在大型建筑中。起始位置限制了探索的房间，并且在不同房间开始的开源模型，在最终房间选择上的一致性不比随机选择高出多少。此外，这些选择受到语义先验的偏见：交换房间的标签通常足以改变最终选择。最后，运动噪声使物体位置误差增加（闭源模型增加12-60%），强黑暗使地图召回率降低28-31个百分点，浓烟使可见物体减少25-39个百分点，而进入房间的选择没有显著变化。
AI.summary: 本研究引入EMRD评估框架，旨在量化视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在安全关键场景中进行空间探索、建图、记忆和决策的就绪性。通过对11个VLM在多种环境条件下的测试，发现现有VLM在环境探索、物体检测和长期记忆方面存在显著不足，且其决策易受语义先验和环境压力的影响，揭示了当前VLM在具身智能应用中的局限性。
AI.keywords: VLM, 安全关键场景, 具身智能, 空间推理, EMRD
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入EMRD框架，系统性地评估了VLM在具身、安全关键场景中的空间推理能力，其创新点在于将复杂的空间推理任务细化为探索、建图、记忆和决策四个阶段，并设计了细致的评估指标。研究结果揭示了当前VLM在处理未探索区域、维持长期记忆和抗环境干扰方面的显著局限性，尤其是在开源模型中。这对于推动VLM在机器人和安全领域的实际应用具有重要指导意义，但也指出需要更多关注模型在鲁棒性、记忆力和避免语义偏见方面的提升。

title: PARAGraph: Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
summary: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a leading cause of vision loss among working-age adults worldwide, making reliable severity grading clinically important. Despite strong performance, most deep models formulate DR grading as image-level classification and do not explicitly model clinically grounded evidence, such as lesion types and spatial relations. In this paper, we propose PARAGraph, a Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph framework for DR grading. PARAGraph represents each image as a three-level hierarchical graph with lesion-level nodes, intermediate category and region nodes, and global anatomical and semantic nodes. To incorporate medical priors into nodes, we construct an optic disc-fovea-anchored coordinate frame that provides a scale- and rotation-normalized retinal reference system. Within this frame, lesion nodes are encoded with category, normalized area, and anatomical coordinates. To mitigate noisy lesion segmentation, PARAGraph uses a dual-fusion strategy that introduces global visual context into a graph semantic node and a decision-level prediction branch, improving robustness when lesion evidence is unreliable. Extensive experiments on Messidor-2, APTOS, and DDR show that PARAGraph achieves consistent DR grading performance over state-of-the-art methods. Interpretability and robustness analyses further demonstrate that its predictions are clinically grounded, closely associated with lesion evidence and robust to lesion segmentation noise.

AI.title_translation: 糖尿病视网膜病变的病理解剖感知分层图
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PARAGraph的新型分层图框架，用于对糖尿病视网膜病变进行分级，该框架通过整合病灶类型、空间关系以及解剖学信息来提高准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 当前的深度学习模型在对糖尿病视网膜病变进行分级时，通常将其视为图像级分类问题，未能充分利用病灶类型和空间关系等临床依据。因此，需要一种能够显式建模这些临床信息的模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为PARAGraph（病理解剖感知分层图）的框架，它将图像表示为三层分层图，包括病灶节点、中间类别和区域节点，以及全局解剖和语义节点。该框架构建了一个以视盘-黄斑为中心的坐标系，用于归一化视网膜的尺度和旋转，并在此坐标系中对病灶节点进行编码。为了处理分割噪声，PARAGraph采用了双融合策略，将全局视觉上下文融入图语义节点和决策级预测分支。
AI.result: PARAGraph在Messidor-2、APTOS和DDR数据集上实现了与最先进方法相当的糖尿病视网膜病变分级性能。可解释性和鲁棒性分析表明，该模型预测具有临床依据，与病灶证据密切相关，并且对病灶分割噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PARAGraph通过其病理解剖感知分层图方法，能够准确、可解释且鲁棒地对糖尿病视网膜病变进行分级，优于现有方法，并能有效处理病灶分割不确定性的情况。
AI.translation: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）仍然是全球工龄成年人失明的主要原因，因此可靠的严重程度分级在临床上至关重要。尽管大多数深度模型表现强劲，但它们通常将DR分级视为图像级分类，并且没有明确地对临床依据（如病灶类型和空间关系）进行建模。在本文中，我们提出了PARAGraph，一种用于DR分级的病理解剖感知分层图框架。PARAGraph将每个图像表示为一个三层分层图，包含病灶级节点、中间类别和区域节点，以及全局解剖和语义节点。为了将医学先验知识融入节点，我们构建了一个以视盘为中心的视盘-黄斑坐标系，提供了一个尺度和旋转归一化的视网膜参考系统。在此框架内，病灶节点根据类别、归一化面积和解剖坐标进行编码。为了减轻噪声病灶分割的影响，PARAGraph采用双融合策略，将全局视觉上下文引入图语义节点和一个决策级预测分支，在病灶证据不可靠时提高鲁棒性。在Messidor-2、APTOS和DDR上的广泛实验表明，PARAGraph在DR分级性能上始终优于最先进的方法。可解释性和鲁棒性分析进一步证明，其预测具有临床依据，与病灶证据密切相关，并且对病灶分割噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PARAGraph的新型框架，用于对糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）进行分级。与传统的将DR分级视为图像级分类的方法不同，PARAGraph构建了一个三层分层图来表示图像，显式地整合了病灶信息、解剖结构和全局上下文。该框架通过引入一个以视盘-黄斑为中心的坐标系来标准化视网膜信息，并采用双融合策略来提高模型对病灶分割噪声的鲁棒性。实验结果表明，PARAGraph在多个数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，并且其预测具有良好的临床可解释性和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 糖尿病视网膜病变, 分级, 分层图, 病理解剖感知, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的分层图方法来解决糖尿病视网膜病变的严重程度分级问题。通过显式地整合病灶信息、解剖学结构以及全局上下文，并采用新颖的坐标系和双融合策略来提高鲁棒性，该方法在性能和可解释性方面均取得了显著的进步。未来可以进一步探索该框架在其他医学图像分析任务中的应用潜力。

title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
summary: Software systems accumulate dependencies and design commitments over time, while the agents that modify them operate within bounded sessions. How, then, can development remain cumulative across generations of transient agents? We introduce EvoX Genesis, which organizes development as a persistent recursive software world. Agents enter an accepted repository version, delegate work within local scopes, and submit changes for verification and parent review. Once accepted, those changes pass to later episodes together with the contracts and tests used to assess them. The project thus preserves both earlier work and a basis for evaluating what comes next. We examine this continuity through four studies of formation, continuation and redevelopment. Starting without compiler code, Genesis built a C compiler with 219,676 lines of Rust source through 1,019 agent episodes over 123.4 hours. Within this growing implementation, repairs increased passes on a fixed set of 100 Csmith programs from 61 to 93; a subsequent revision retained all 93 passes. Development also continued in a separate compiler lineage when DeepSeek V4 Flash inherited a GLM 5.2 snapshot. To examine continuity when the implementation itself changes, Genesis redeveloped selected MESA functionality in Rust, with numerical agreement assessed against the Fortran reference across six workloads. The WebGL trajectory, meanwhile, exposed both repairs and regressions as repeated checks recorded progress towards 2,017/2,019 conformance pages passed. A complementary EvoX Compiler case connects program-merging performance to executable graph and backend contracts. Together, these records trace how accepted work becomes a foundation for further development: later agents inherit both usable implementations and concrete ways to assess further revisions.

title: Twisted Conjugacy and the Construction of Induced Centrosymmetric Alternant Codes
comments: Keywords: Alternant codes, Generalized Reed--Solomon codes, automorphism groups, twisted conjugacy, projective semilinear group
summary: This paper presents a construction of induced centrosymmetric alternant codes based on the automorphism structures inherited from Generalized Reed-Solomon (GRS) codes. We introduce a twisted conjugacy relation naturally arising from projective semilinear transformations and establish its connection with ordinary conjugacy in the corresponding projective semilinear coset. By means of the Shintani norm, we show that, in the quadratic extension case, all admissible transformations inducing centrosymmetry have a trivial Shintani norm and therefore belong to a unique conjugacy class in the semilinear coset. We further characterize the explicit forms of these transformations and establish a transport theorem describing how twisted conjugation acts on the supports and multipliers of GRS codes. These results provide an algebraic framework for constructing and analyzing induced centrosymmetric alternant codes.
comment: Keywords: Alternant codes, Generalized Reed--Solomon codes, automorphism groups, twisted conjugacy, projective semilinear group

title: Semantic Prism: Generative Segmentation with an Explicit Semantic-Image Interface
summary: Conditional image generators can render segmentation maps as semantic RGB images, but color drift and boundary mixing can undermine direct decoding. We present Semantic Prism, a framework that combines an explicit semantic-image interface with hierarchical refinement for road-scene segmentation. A generator adapted from a diffusion-distilled backbone produces a semantic RGB image with a single denoising update per crop. Distances to a fixed class-color codebook define interface logits and pixelwise class probabilities. Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment (HGEA) combines spatially aligned multilevel features from the VAE encoder of the generator with the input image, generated semantic image, and interface probabilities to predict additive corrections to these logits. Contextual Interface Hierarchy Disagreement (C-IHD) combines pointwise uncertainty, local context, and interface-refinement disagreement in a fixed score for ranking pixel errors, without an auxiliary predictor or an additional network pass. On the 500-image Cityscapes validation set, Semantic Prism achieves 72.07% mean mIoU, improving on direct-interface decoding by 11.39 percentage points. Extensive capacity-matched ablations show higher mean mIoU for multilevel refinement than for flat and single-level alternatives. The Cityscapes-trained model transfers to ACDC Dataset, achieving 46.89% mIoU without target-domain adaptation. Beyond Cityscapes, on BDD100K dataset, a separately trained model achieves 62.22% mIoU on its full 1,000-image validation set. Across the 3 evaluated datasets, C-IHD improves pixel-error area under the AUPR over uncertainty derived from maximum softmax probability, with segmentation predictions held fixed for each comparison. In particular, on ACDC, AUPR increases from 0.6580 to 0.7557, demonstrating that Semantic Prism presents more effective error ranking under adverse-condition domain shift.

title: On the Feasibility of Image-Based Representations for Air Traffic Complexity Estimation
comments: The authors request withdrawal of this preprint due to institutional administrative requirements related to research publication approval. This withdrawal is not related to any errors in the scientific content of the manuscript
summary: Air traffic controllers perceive traffic complexity through the radar display, suggesting that a computer vision model operating on the same imagery may provide a natural architecture for modeling controller-perceived complexity; however, whether radar imagery is a viable input format for deep learning vision models remains unclear. Unlike natural images, radar images are extremely sparse and self-similar, consisting primarily of a black background and a few visually identical aircraft blobs, while small changes in aircraft positions can substantially alter sector-level complexity. To test whether a vision model can capture these operationally important differences, we encode each traffic situation as a position image supplemented by five channels representing aircraft state variables, including heading, speed, and altitude, and train a Vision Transformer (ViT) to regress four intrinsic complexity components derived from pairwise geometric relations among aircraft. The model achieves $R^2 > 0.96$ for all four components on test data, and a one-aircraft removal perturbation study shows that the change in the model's estimate is proportional to how much the removed aircraft contributed to sector complexity, rather than the same for every removal. These results demonstrate that, despite its atypical visual characteristics, the proposed image-based representation is a viable input format for air traffic complexity modeling.

title: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for human-AI interaction usually trains the agent against a single large language model (LLM) that simulates the user. We show that agents trained this way can systematically fail to generalize, and we trace the failure to simulator collapse: the simulator LLM is mode-collapsed, and a policy trained against it learns narrow strategies that exploit the simulator's mode behavior; these strategies transfer poorly to unseen simulators and to real users. We formalize the collapse and propose two solutions. Verbalized Sampling, applied at inference time, samples each simulator reply from a verbalized response distribution. Co-Training, applied during training similar to self-play, co-evolves the simulator as the policy, so the policy cannot exploit the mode behavior. A population variant samples the simulator for each rollout from a pool of recent checkpoints. We validate both solutions on three benchmarks: Persuasion for Good, tau^2-bench, and CooperBench. Verbalized Sampling improves held-out success by up to 9% over single-simulator RL, and Co-Training pushes gains further to 14%; the human study shows similar gain on real users. Both solutions also preserve the policy diversity that collapses under single-simulator RL. Overall, our findings on simulator collapse point to diverse simulators as a requirement for RL agents that serve real users. We release SCOPE, an open-source framework for Population Co-Training in multi-agent RL.

title: Query Timing Produces Opposite Positional Biases Between LLMs and Humans
comments: EMNLP 2026 Findings; Entropic Award (Top 3 Paper), ICBINB @ ICLR 2026
summary: Positional biases such as recency and primacy effects have been documented in large language models (LLMs), yet the underlying mechanism by which these models make their evaluations remains poorly understood. Both primacy and recency biases have been observed in human judgments in response to evidence, but recent work suggest that when the listener updates their beliefs - during the presentation of evidence or only at the end - influences the presence of such effects. We investigate whether a similar phenomenon holds for LLMs, finding divergence from human behavior. These biases are more pronounced in newer models compared to their predecessors.
comment: EMNLP 2026 Findings; Entropic Award (Top 3 Paper), ICBINB @ ICLR 2026

title: Regularizing patch contributions across domain and category shifts
summary: Visual classification under domain and category shifts requires identifying which image regions provide transferable evidence. Domain alignment alone can retain context that is stable across source domains yet redundant for prediction, while new categories may require different local distinctions. We propose PatchGen to learn image-conditioned soft patch weights and regularize their contributions to the task representation. Low-score suppression acts directly on the weights, while selected-confidence and class-conditional compactness objectives shape the aggregated features using available labels or host-generated pseudo-labels. An oracle predictive-subset analysis characterizes information preservation, complexity upper bounds, and sensitivity to selection error under explicit assumptions. Experiments on natural and histopathological image benchmarks across all three shift settings show that PatchGen improves average performance over matched-backbone baselines in most evaluated configurations, enhances generalization to unknown classes, and remains competitive with vision-language methods without text supervision.

title: Sampling Luck Masquerades as Allocation Gain: Auditing Test-Time Budget Allocation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
comments: v2 adds a correction notice on page 1: the in-distribution headroom is 1.1-1.6%, not zero (see arXiv:2611.06372, Appendix B); the rest is unchanged. 10 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Pre-registered study; code, cost arrays, and the full pre-registration record (including every amendment and its direction) at https://github.com/nepersoned/best-of-k-allocation
summary:
Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) solvers report the best of many sampled solutions per instance, and the sample count is, by convention, identical for every instance. Whether a non-uniform allocation of a fixed total budget would buy anything has not been measured. We measure it, and we audit the measurement itself.
  First, on in-distribution workloads the allocation headroom is not detectable. Across three pretrained solvers (POMO, AM, SymNCO) on uniform TSP-100, an oracle allocation computed and evaluated on the same stored samples reports a 2.2-2.6% gain with intervals excluding zero; measured out of sample the same gain is indistinguishable from zero (0.457, 0.015, -0.512 percent). Following the customary in-sample procedure, all three solvers would have supported a published 2%-level gain that does not exist. We calibrate this bias against an instance-wise null in which the true gain is zero by construction; over the ranges we test it does not shrink with more samples or more instances.
  Second, the same correction that removes the phantom gains preserves a real one. Under distribution shift (a workload mixing uniform and clustered instances), a pre-registered confirmatory experiment finds that allocation guided by held-out sample statistics improves best-of-k by 11.5% (AM, primary endpoint; 95% CI [7.4, 19.7]) and 12.0% (SymNCO, replication) at equal evaluation budget, with the signal-acquisition cost not charged; a pre-registered negative control (POMO, an order of magnitude more robust to shift) shows -0.3% [-0.7, 0.24]. The gain exceeds a frozen distribution-label baseline by 4.2 points [1.9, 7.7]. An exploratory policy charging a 20-sample probe against the same budget retains 3.4% (AM) and 4.6% (SymNCO).
  We give a correction procedure and a reporting checklist, and release all data, code, and the pre-registration record.

title: Asymmetric Discourse Homogenization on Reddit Was a Text-Length Artifact: A Reanalysis
comments: 18 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. This version replaces v1 entirely: the v1 headline finding (asymmetric conservative homogenization after ChatGPT) was an artifact of comment length in the similarity measure. The artifact is documented in general form in arXiv:2611.21519
summary: In the first version of this paper I reported that conservative Reddit users began writing more alike after ChatGPT was released while progressive users did not. That result came from a similarity measure that rises and falls with comment length. I redo every analysis of the original paper on all 6,056,593 comments with a sentence encoder and a dispersion measure computed within length strata, and the conservative break goes away. The two camps show no reliable difference in how within-group similarity changed after late 2022, and the ChatGPT date behaves like any of the more than two thousand other cutoffs I test. The matched flair comparison, the cumulative AI index, the stayer panel and the entropy signature each lose their support once length is held fixed. The one change that survives is older. Left and right comments drew closer to each other between 2019 and 2022, and that convergence was complete before ChatGPT arrived. I end with what this implies for studies that measure homogenization with embeddings.
